svg.title: Plugins: one real call, and the line between what you can swap and what judges it
svg.desc: Above a line, thirteen live rows, each in one socket; any of them can be swapped. One, the factors row, computed a reading for Goldwind on 2026-10-08: trend off, 31.8 percent under its 200-day average. In the middle, your agent argued a bull case and a bear case over that reading and wrote a plan: watch, act only above 8.97 within five sessions, dead at 8.923, confidence 0.34. Below the line is what is not a row: code took 8.645 as the reference, the first tradable price after publication, marked the next close 4.22 percent lower, called it a loss, and kept it on the public ledger. No row can change that part.

text.tspan: Swap what computes. Not what a result is allowed to do.
One real call, Goldwind · 02208, 2026-10-08: what was a row, and what was not.
the factors row read its daily bars: trend off, 31.8% under its 200-day average
YOUR AGENT ARGUES OVER THE READING
The only peer with a confirmation
price you could act on, and the book
holds little outside HK tech and AI.
Trend off, four risk limits already
NOT ROWS · THE SAME CODE JUDGES EVERY STRATEGY
The first tradable price after publication,
marked at the close of the next session.
On the public ledger, and counted by the
track record the next brief reads.
No row can mark its own call, move the
reference, change the outcome or leave it out.
